cases.description: An inaccessible saved URL remains observable and retryable without invented synthesis.
review_checks: No detailed summary is inferred from the queue headline.
No filler page or PR is created from the inaccessible source alone.

cases.description: A source that duplicates an existing concept without adding useful information produces no change.

review_checks: Existing useful content and provenance remain intact.
New prose is concise original synthesis and the source relationship is visible.
No duplicate concept page is introduced.
